newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB sells wheat to Iran, Phillipines - trade.
newsitem.headline: CWB sells wheat to Iran, Phillipines - trade.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board sold more than 500,000 tonnes of mostly hard red spring wheat to Iran and more than 100,000 tonnes of hard red spring wheat to the Phillipines, grain trade sources said.
"They did the business to Iran. It's primarily hard red spring (wheat). It's direct business between the Board and the grain trading corporation of Iran," one source said.

The CWB sold more than 500,000 tonnes of mostly Canada Western Red Spring and some Western Canada Prairie Spring wheat to Iran for May/June delivery, the source said, citing Vancouver vessel manifests.
"The CWB neither confirms nor denies any sales," CWB spokeswoman Tracey Thompson said.
European Union grain sources said earlier Wednesday Iran may have bought up to 500,000 tonnes of Canadian soft wheat.
The CWB also sold three cargo loads of hard red spring milling wheat to the Phillipines last week for a total of slightly more than 100,000 tonnes, another source said.
Price and delivery period were not specified.
